# Reply

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Answers the call the caller is holding.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x06` SVC_REPLY | — | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err Reply(uint32_t xlen, Handle grant_handle);
```

**Registers:** `(xlen, grant, -1, 0) -> r0 status`

The reply is the first `xlen` bytes of the server's message box. If the caller's CallTimeout() expired after the call was received, the call has been withdrawn and there is nothing to answer.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `xlen` | in | Reply length in bytes, at most MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| `grant_handle` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) (with PERM_TXFR) to copy to the caller, or -1. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../errors.md#err_overflow) | `xlen` is larger than MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The caller has died. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | There is no call to answer (none was received, or the caller timed out and withdrew it), or `grant_handle` is not live. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `grant_handle` lacks PERM_TXFR; the caller is failed with this error. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | The caller's handle table is full; the caller is failed with this error. |
